name: Osmosis Analyst
description:
Osmosis Analyst gives Claude live, read-only access to the Osmosis knowledge graph of institutional allocators — public pension funds, endowments, foundations, insurers, sovereign funds and family offices — so investment-relations, capital-raising and research teams can answer allocator questions with sourced, current data instead of stale databases.

Ask Claude to find qualified leads and buying signals for a strategy (e.g. private credit, infrastructure, emerging-market equity), brief an allocator before a meeting, list recent board and investment-committee meetings with what was discussed, track personnel moves and board changes, see which consultants are advising on which mandates, and pull Form 5500 / Form 990 filings, plan holdings and service-provider relationships. A prepare-for-CRM tool returns structured fields ready to paste into your pipeline.

Every answer is grounded in Osmosis-indexed meeting transcripts, documents and regulatory filings, with citations. All 31 tools are read-only: nothing is written back to Osmosis or your data. Sign in with your Osmosis account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Osmosis Analyst to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Osmosis Analyst to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.osmosis.fm/mcp/tools. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Osmosis Analyst MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Osmosis Analyst lists 31 MCP tools, including brief_allocator, find_allocator, find_allocator_signals_for_strategy, find_allocators_by_criteria, find_consultant_activity, find_plans_by_dfe, find_plans_by_holding, find_plans_by_service_provider, find_private_credit_leads, find_qualified_leads, get_dfe_investments_for_plan, and get_form5500_filing_detail.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Osmosis Analyst?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Osmosis Analyst in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Osmosis Analyst MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Osmosis Analyst requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Osmosis Analyst is developed by Osmosis Technologies Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
